spec_match.rationale: Implements the explainer's document-level tracking note verbatim (capturing uareplacestart listener plus per-element once uareplaceend), and mirrors Chromium's Event::Create non-bubbling dispatch, citing html_image_element.cc.

interactive.rationale: Radio target selection, synthetic start/end dispatch, per-image state chips, capture-vs-bubble counters, a status live region, and an event log all change in response to real controls.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the capture-pattern inspection tool with the capture-vs-bubble proof; the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers ending a never-started replacement (logged, not crashed), duplicate starts (set-guarded), the snapshot scan for pre-script replacements with the honest property-absent readout, and the bubble-listener control group that stays at zero.

references.rationale: See-also links the explainer, the Chromium implementation file that proves the non-bubbling claim, and the chromestatus.com/feature/5076374013476864 entry.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite pins the exact member and handler-attribute contracts this monitor depends on; the page's shared support panel renders those verdicts honestly in this build.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP harness selected targets 2 and 3, dispatched start/end, and verified chips, capture count 2, bubble count 0, status text listing the replaced image, and log rows; zero console errors; full-page screenshot read and judged.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts capture-listener observation, per-element end tracking, and that the bubble-phase listener stayed silent after dispatch.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; the replaced chip inverts to text-black on ivory as a pair; fieldset/legend styling keeps AA contrast on stone.

accessibility.rationale: Target choice is a native radio group in a fieldset with legend, the monitor status is a polite role=status region summarising replaced counts, chips mirror state as text (not colour alone), and the log list is labelled.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The layout collapses to one column at 820px with the image grid staying two-up at readable sizes; feature-level responsive-check recorded desktop clean and mobile 0-overflow, and radio labels/buttons meet the 44px minimum.

guidanceConsulted.query: radio group fieldset legend accessible name for demo controls
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native radio inputs grouped in a fieldset with a legend rather than custom toggles; announce aggregate state through one polite region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Target selection is a native radio fieldset; per-event log rows stay out of live regions while the summary status announces the replaced count.

guidanceConsulted.query: two panel inspection layout collapsing on narrow viewports
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: minmax(0,1fr) grid tracks and single-column collapse below a content-driven breakpoint.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Stage grid collapses at 820px; the watched-image grid uses repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)) so cells shrink without overflow; verified via the feature responsive-check run.

summary: Replacement Monitor turns the explainer's capture-listener pattern into an inspection tool and proves the non-bubbling propagation claim with a live capture-vs-bubble counter pair. CDP verification confirmed multi-image tracking, per-element end handling, a permanently-zero bubble counter, and clean console.
